title: OCR runtimes: GGUF vs MLX
finding: No llama.cpp arm passes. D4 (dots.mocr GGUF Q8_0) matches the shipped backend but is not faster (1.29 times on the gate pages, about 1.0 times when the shipped backend is re-timed alone; needs 2 times). P4 (PaddleOCR-VL GGUF Q8_0) is 12 times faster but has invented text on 10 of 25 review pages, as does the shipped backend on 15 of the same 25. The 16-bit diagnostics fail the same way, so the 8-bit step is not the main cause. Both shipped backends stay. The operator asked for a separate proposal to move dots.mocr to llama.cpp for no PyTorch, one runtime and lower memory, not for speed.
